severity.intentNote: Method v3.3 (2026-09-29): intent over body count. A gated file is placed in a band by the dominant documented intent of its harm: extermination (killing civilians was the goal) and predation (personal murder or abuse for one's own ends) share the floor, 0-25, as does anyone who killed or abused with their own hands ('personal'). war_or_policy and incidental harm places 30-90, above every file on the floor. Inside a band the v3.2 points still order the files (directing below instrument, more below fewer), scaled to the band. Severities without an intent keep the v3.2 placement (cap - points).
